caption: The drawing depicts two wooden eating utensils—a spoon and a fork—arranged diagonally across a plain, light beige background. Both utensils are a medium brown color with darker shading to indicate the grain and depth of the wood. The handles of the spoon and fork are elaborately carved with decorative motifs featuring clusters of small rounded shapes (resembling berries or grapes) and large leaves that curve and overlap toward the end of each handle. The spoon is positioned above the fork, with their handles oriented to the left and the working ends (bowl of the spoon, tines of the fork) oriented to the right. Fine lines and subtle color variations add texture and detail to the carved patterns and the surfaces of the utensils. In the lower right corner of the image, there is a small handwritten signature.
title: Wooden Spoon and Fork
